reasoning: A light, stark, high-contrast theme signals clarity, authority, and premium quality, ideal for a financial AI tool. Avoiding the generic dark-mode 'crypto-bro' aesthetic in favor of a trustworthy, institutional, yet modern 'Swiss' look. Pure whites, deep blacks, and a singular metallic gold accent.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H3. Keep leading-none for H1.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, and UI labels.

mono.usage: Use EXCLUSIVELY for ticker prices, performance numbers, account balances, and the emriz.eth footer badge.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Allow the typography and data to breathe.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento grids for features and performance metrics (Mode B: The 'Control Room' grid but airy). 1px borders to separate items.

buttons.primary: bg-[#111111] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium transition-all hover:bg-gray-800
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#111111] border border-gray-200 rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium transition-all hover:border-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-50
buttons.accent: bg-[#C5A059] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium transition-all hover:bg-[#b38f4d]

cards.style: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
cards.usage: Use for AI Analysis Preview, How It Works, and Download Center.

ticker.style: bg-[#111111] text-white py-3 px-4 font-mono text-sm border-b border-gray-800 flex items-center gap-6 overflow-hidden
ticker.usage: Live Gold Price Ticker at the very top of the page.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for the Performance Charts section to give it a technical, analytical feel.
visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle fade-ins on scroll, delicate hover lifts for cards. Keep it strictly professional.
visual_enhancers.charts: Recharts. Use area charts with a subtle gradient fill (Emerald/Green to transparent) on a pure white background with dotted grid lines.

hero_background.description: Premium, clean abstract background. Use in the Hero section as a subtle background image with low opacity (e.g., mix-blend-multiply or opacity-40) over the #F8F9FA background.

ai_gold_illustration.description: 3D AI microchip intersecting with a gold coin. Use in the 'How It Works' or 'AI Analysis' section as a primary visual asset.

stock_market_display.description: Digital stock market display. Use inside the 'Performance' or 'Trade.com Broker Partner' section as a masked background.

specific_functionalities.live_gold_ticker: Place at the very top (above navbar). Black background, white mono text. Green/Red arrows for price movement.
specific_functionalities.ai_analysis_preview: Bento card in hero or section 2. White card, gray border. Show a mock 'GPT-5.2 Insight' with typing effect or just clean static text: 'XAUUSD Bias: BULLISH'.
specific_functionalities.broker_partner: Section featuring Trade.com. Use typography and layout to make it look official. 'Preferred Broker Partner: Trade.com'.
specific_functionalities.purchase_form: Clean, highly trustworthy form for Paystack NGN. Minimal inputs, clear total, prominent secure payment badges.
specific_functionalities.footer: Generous padding, dark background (#111111) to contrast the light page. Include 'emriz.eth' badge prominently (e.g., 'Built by emriz.eth' in JetBrains Mono).

instructions_to_main_agent: Delete any existing dark mode implementations. The entire app MUST be a light theme.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Stick to Clash Display.
For the charts (Recharts), ensure the tooltip and axes use the JetBrains Mono font and match the light theme (white background, gray border).
Use Phosphor icons with `weight="duotone"` for a high-end look.
Ensure the hero background image is implemented such that text remains 100% readable (WCAG AAA).
Use standard HTML + Tailwind for major layout sections, do not over-rely on Shadcn Card if it restricts the premium bento layout.
